# DuraLex

> Legal practice software in development, built by attorneys inside a working multi-practice law firm in Philadelphia founded by Robert Bond, Esq. DuraLex is designed to read a firm's notices and documents, record each fact with the page it came from, and route the work to the right person for the attorney to approve. It is in early access; each page marks what runs today and what is next, in build, coming or planned.

What runs today:
- Invoicing and payments.
- Google Drive and Dropbox connections.

In the founding firm's workflow, being built into DuraLex:
- Google Docs eSignature for engagement letters and fee agreements.
- Independent verification of citations and quotations before anything is filed or sent.

Next, in build, coming or planned:
- Court notices by email becoming dated, assigned deadlines (next); court-system connections (planned).
- OneDrive and Box connections (coming).
- Bank connection, QuickBooks recording, client trust ledgers and three-way IOLTA reconciliation (planned).
- Texting clients from the firm's own number (coming); post-quantum encryption (coming).

Principles:
- AI supports the attorney's judgment and never substitutes for it. Nothing enters the record or goes to a client until an attorney approves it.
- Firm files stay in the firm's own cloud storage.

## Pages

- [Home](https://duralex.law/): what DuraLex does, a running demo with sample data (conflict check, letterhead drafting, engagement letter, fee agreement), services and pricing, integrations and FAQ.
- [Practices](https://duralex.law/practices/): a sample matter in eight practice areas from first call to closing letter.
- [Calendar](https://duralex.law/calendar/): how court notices are planned to become dated, assigned deadlines on the right calendar.
- [Accounting](https://duralex.law/accounting/): the planned bank connection, QuickBooks recording, three-way IOLTA reconciliation and dashboards by role.
- [Client portal](https://duralex.law/portal/): what clients will see: case status, next date, documents, messages and billing.
- [Client portal demo](https://duralex.law/portal-demo/): a tappable phone demo with two sample cases, previewed in six languages (English, Ukrainian, Uzbek, Spanish, Portuguese and Greek).
